Emerald Soul Diamond – Eau de Parfum ✨

Inspired by the enchanting twilight sky and the gentle breeze of nature, Emerald Soul Diamond captures the magic of the night's first moments in a captivating fragrance.

A refreshing opening of bergamot, mandarin, and white musk creates a bright and elegant impression. The heart reveals refreshing spices and lemon, adding a lively touch, while a warm base of vanilla and amber leaves a soft, sensual, and comforting trail.

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Musk
  • Heart Notes: Refreshing Spices, Lemon
  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber

A beautiful balance of freshness, warmth, and elegance, perfect for those who appreciate distinctive and refined fragrances.
